name: Best Buy (US big-box) RDNA4 consumer discrete GPU channel
price_basis: Gigabyte Radeon RX 9070 XT Gaming OC 16GB GDDR6 PCIe 5.0 bare card, SKU 6617866, Best Buy, pre-tax, observed 2026-10-03. Peer listing XFX Swift RX 9070 XT 16GB at $909.99, with a third at $929.99.
notes: Scoped to what this channel actually stocks: RDNA4 consumer boards, with 'Add to cart' live on both SKUs. Two negative findings are the reason this record is narrow and its accelerator_ids list is deliberately thin. First, there is no accelerator record in this repo for the Radeon RX 9070 XT, so that part is described here but cannot be referenced as an id - a supply record is not the place to create one. Second, Best Buy returned no RTX 3090 and no RTX 4090 SKU on these consumer-GPU searches, and its B580 search returned only facet metadata with no priced product, so this retailer is not a viable channel for GeForce or for Arc. The $869.99-$929.99 band lines up closely with B&H's ASUS Prime RX 9070 XT OC at $829.99 and the GIGABYTE board from EUR 757.16 on Geizhals, so RDNA4 pricing is consistent across US retail and the EU.
